# E6: Durability & Extended Life

**Display ID:** E6  
**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** No  
**Category:** Environmental Impact Reduction and Transparency  
**Applicability:** Project  
**Project types:** Print, Digital, Hybrid, Packaging, Signage, Exhibit, Website, App  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 9, SDG 11, SDG 12

## Summary
Integrates extended-life durability through reuse, repair, recharge, and/or upgrade where appropriate.

## Criteria
The product or system is physically durable and has a longer life than the industry average, where desirable. The product or system can be reused, recharged, repaired, and/or upgraded as an environmental benefit.

## Why it matters
Product design for longer life than the industry average.
